crops.kind: Exact saved 24x24 uint8 crops on accepted frames; missing input is zero

heat.display_encoding: Per-frame max normalized to 255 for visibility; not model input values

video.frame_mapping: Output frame i corresponds exactly to source frame 183+i; frames decoded sequentially before re-encoding

provenance.observations: detection_uv_px is the original saved detector output in source pixels. observed is the accepted mask in the actual adapted model inputs. observations_px is zero where rejected; no interpolation.
provenance.court: Manually confirmed floor and net anchors; not automatically detected court corners.
provenance.labels_usage: label_uv_px is human 2D evaluation annotation only, never used as detected positions; not shown by default.
provenance.depth: No measured real 3D truth. XYZ is existing network prediction with existing geometric/temporal correction.
